title: Mechanics of Bias and Reasoning: Interpreting the Impact of Chain-of-Thought Prompting on Gender Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks adapted to include stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, and unknown options to compute a Diff-Bias score. Internal bias mechanisms are also evaluated using a Stereotype Attention Score (SAS) to measure attention given to sensitive tokens, hidden state probing classifiers to predict selected answer types, and qualitative failure analysis of reasoning chains.
